questions.q: Which is NOT a suitable way to measure the size of a business?
questions.why: Profit depends on costs and prices as well as size, so it is not a measure of size.

questions.q: A car manufacturer takes over a company that supplies its tyres. What type of integration is this?
questions.why: Buying a supplier (an earlier stage of production) is backward vertical integration.

questions.q: Which of these is an external stakeholder?
questions.why: Suppliers are outside the business; managers, employees and owners are internal stakeholders.

questions.q: Explain one difference between a merger and a takeover.
questions.model: In a merger the owners of two businesses agree to join together to form one business; in a takeover one business buys out the owners of another, which becomes part of it.
points: takeover = one business buys the other
